transcript.content: You are a helpful assistant with access to various tools. Use the tools provided to complete the task. Be concise and efficient. If you need to perform multiple steps, do them in sequence.

# Network Diagnostics Report Task

Create a comprehensive network diagnostics report that includes connectivity tests and DNS resolution information.

## Requirements

1. Test connectivity to the following hosts:
   - google.com
   - cloudflare.com
   - github.com

2. Perform DNS resolution for:
   - example.com
   - wikipedia.org
   - stackoverflow.com

3. Create a report file at `/workspace/network_report.txt` that includes:
   - A header "Network Diagnostics Report"
   - A timestamp of when the report was generated
   - Ping results for each host (showing if reachable)
   - DNS resolution results for each domain (showing resolved IP addresses)
   - A summary section at the end

4. The report should be well-formatted and easy to read with clear sections.

Complete this task using the available terminal commands.

I'll create a comprehensive network diagnostics report by testing connectivity and DNS resolution, then compile the results into a formatted report file.
<function_calls>
<invoke name="bash">
<parameter name="command">cat > /workspace/network_report.txt << 'EOF'
================================================================================
                    NETWORK DIAGNOSTICS REPORT
================================================================================

Report Generated: $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
System: $(uname -s)
Hostname: $(hostname)

================================================================================
                        CONNECTIVITY TESTS (PING)
================================================================================

EOF
</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>
<function_calls>
<invoke name="bash">
<parameter name="command">
# Test connectivity to google.com
echo "Testing: google.com" >> /workspace/network_report.txt
echo "---" >> /workspace/network_report.txt
if ping -c 3 -W 5 google.com 2>&1 | head -20 >> /workspace/network_report.txt; then
    echo "Status: ✓ REACHABLE" >> /workspace/network_report.txt
else
    echo "Status: ✗ UNREACHABLE" >> /workspace/network_report.txt
fi
echo "" >> /workspace/network_report.txt
</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>
